nodes.text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a COMMON, usually MILD, URTI virus.
It’s like a mini RSV. 
If you are worried about HMPV then you have not worked as a clinician on the wards for long.
Cases seem to stabilising in the UK and US at similar, or lower levels, as last year.
